_note: Verified from the apps' code on 13 Oct 2026 (research agents, spot-checked). status: live | gated | partial | not_live | general. Only live (or general) features may be shown in a Reel or post. engine/claims.py enforces this.

fresh-name.name: Fresh name every day
fresh-name.summary: On first open each day the app asks the server for the account's generated name and emoji avatar for that date (cached on the phone for the day), shows it in the Wall header and on every post, and a local 9:00 reminder says 'You're someone new today'.
fresh-name.story_hook: Priya opens the app on the bus home and finds she is 'VelvetEcho29' today.
fresh-name.safe_wording: Every day the app gives you a new generated name and emoji avatar to post under.
fresh-name.note: Backend: get_effective_identity / get_or_create_daily_identity and the daily_identities table are in the live schema snapshot (11 Oct). The day boundary is the UTC date. The 9:00 'someone new today' reminder is scheduled only after the person has allowed notifications. Posts still carry the account's author id (the Wall reads post.author_id for badges and ownership) and the 9 Oct audit found stable ids exposed, so do not claim names cannot be linked across days; the in-app Reveal line 'nobody will recognize you' is an overclaim.

customize-name.name: Customize name and avatar
customize-name.summary: From the pencil icon on the Wall (or the Reveal screen) you type an optional name of up to 20 characters and pick an emoji from seven groups; it is saved to custom_identities for 24 hours, words like admin, official or waypoint are refused, and it replaces your generated name on new posts.
customize-name.story_hook: Arjun wants to post as 'Night Owl' with an owl avatar this evening, so he edits his name first.
customize-name.safe_wording: Pick your own name of up to 20 characters and an emoji avatar for the next 24 hours.
customize-name.note: Reserved-name check also enforced in the database (reject_reserved_custom_name). About 100 emoji in 7 groups (Animals, Nature, Zodiac, Mood objects, Masks, Strange little worlds, Waypoint symbols). This is the only 'themes' style choice in the app.

wall-feed.name: The Wall feed
wall-feed.summary: The Wall tab shows a weighted-shuffled feed from get_ranked_feed of other people's text, poll and voice posts with name, age, feeling tag and actions, plus the Moments strip, the green Official card, a prompt card, pull-to-refresh and a Daily Path widget.
wall-feed.story_hook: Mei scrolls the Wall on her lunch break and reads what strangers wrote that morning.
wall-feed.safe_wording: The Wall is a shared feed where you read posts from other people and react to them.
wall-feed.note: Blocked authors and posts you reported are removed from your feed; posts removed by automated review are hidden (report_count sentinel). The in-app FAQ says posts stay up 30 days, but no 30-day expiry job exists in the repo (only the My Waypoints view is limited to 30 days); the live get_ranked_feed SQL is not in the repo so this is unverified.

write-post.name: Write a post
write-post.summary: On the Create tab you write up to 500 words (3,000 characters), choose one feeling tag, and tap Post; the text is checked by the pre-publish filter, inserted into posts under today's name, and a 'How do you feel now?' card holds the screen for up to 6 seconds before you land on the Wall.
write-post.story_hook: Tunde types one sentence about his day on the train and posts it before his stop.
write-post.safe_wording: Write up to 500 words, pick a feeling, and post it to the Wall under today's name.
write-post.note: The in-app button reads 'Post anonymously' (forbidden word in captions). Posting earns 5 points; rate limit enforced server-side; the push-permission ask follows the first post.

feelings-tags.name: Eight feelings per post
feelings-tags.summary: Every post carries one of eight feelings (frustrated, anxious, lonely, tired, angry, happy, grateful, calm) picked on Create, shown as a chip on the card, used by the Wall's feeling chips to narrow the feed, and used to decide which reaction set the post offers.
feelings-tags.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion.
feelings-tags.story_hook: Sara tags her post 'grateful' after a good call with her sister.
feelings-tags.safe_wording: Tag each post with one of eight feelings, and narrow the Wall to a single feeling with one tap.
feelings-tags.note: Do not list the full set in captions: 'lonely' and 'calm' are on the forbidden list. Older builds only have two tags (frustrated, happy).

voice-posts.name: Voice posts
voice-posts.summary: On Create you record up to 60 seconds, pick a Bear, Fox or Sparrow character and post; a server function transcribes it, screens the transcript, re-speaks it in a synthetic voice in that character and deletes the raw recording, and the Wall plays the synthetic version, which is removed after 7 days.
voice-posts.story_hook: Kofi would rather say his piece out loud than type it, so he records 30 seconds and picks the Bear voice.
voice-posts.safe_wording: Record up to 60 seconds, pick a Bear, Fox or Sparrow voice, and the Wall plays your words back in that synthetic voice; voice posts are removed after 7 days.
voice-posts.note: Confirmed working end to end on 13 Sep (Google speech-to-text and text-to-speech); fails closed since 10 Oct (rejected and hidden if conversion fails). Do not claim 'nobody hears your real voice' or 'never raw': the raw file is first uploaded to the voice-posts bucket, which is still public in the 11 Oct snapshot, and is deleted after conversion; the transcript is kept server-side with a crisis flag. Needs microphone permission and a valid Anthropic key (tone reading).

polls.name: Ask the Path polls
polls.summary: Ask the Path on Create lets you write a question with 2 to 4 options; other people vote once, see percentages after voting, and the author sees results straight away (own polls cannot be voted on).
polls.story_hook: Ana cannot decide whether to take the night shift, so she asks the Wall with a two-option poll.
polls.safe_wording: Ask a question with two to four options and everyone else on the Wall can vote once and see the percentages.
polls.note: poll_options and poll_votes tables are in the live snapshot. getPollData reads voter user ids on the client, so make no claim that votes cannot be linked. The in-app note says polls last 30 days (unverified server-side).

reactions.name: Reactions on posts
reactions.summary: Under other people's posts you tap one reaction (thumbs up, thumbs down, laugh, not sure; or I hear you / Same / You've got this on the hard feelings), which updates the counts, earns 1 point, plays a burst animation and sends the author a notification whose text is built on the server.
reactions.story_hook: Ravi reads a stranger's post about a rough commute and taps the reaction that says he has been there too.
reactions.safe_wording: Tap one reaction under a post to let its author know it reached you; the counts show on the post.
reactions.note: You cannot react to your own post. Tap again to remove or change. The three supportive reactions replace the four standard ones on posts tagged with a hard feeling (first for 'frustrated' on 10 Oct, for all five hard feelings in v25).

private-replies.name: Reply to a post's author
private-replies.summary: Under another person's text or poll post, 'Reply privately' opens a sheet to send ONE message of up to 500 characters (10 a day, screened first); only the post's author sees replies under 'Replies (n)' on their own post and can report one or block its sender, but cannot answer, and the sender learns nothing back.
private-replies.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion.
private-replies.story_hook: Lena reads a post about a hard week and sends the writer one kind sentence.
private-replies.safe_wording: Send the author of a post one short reply of up to 500 characters; the author can read it, report it or block the sender, but cannot answer.
private-replies.note: True mechanic: one-way, one message per post, no thread, no way to start a chat, replier sees no read or report status, author cannot see who sent it. The in-app label is 'Reply privately' and the defining promise is 'only they will read this', so a plain caption needs 'private' unless reworded. Server screening of replies is client-side and fails open (known gap). Marketing item wp-reply ('you choose whether to answer') is wrong: the author cannot answer.

say-thanks.name: Say thanks
say-thanks.summary: On your own post, once people have reacted, 'Say thanks' (thank_reactors) sends every reacting person one quiet notification with no names, once per post.
say-thanks.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion.
say-thanks.story_hook: After six people react to his post, Dev taps Say thanks before going to sleep.
say-thanks.safe_wording: Once people have reacted to your post, one tap on Say thanks sends each of them a short thank-you note with no names.
say-thanks.note: Remembered per post on the phone so it reads 'Thanked' afterwards. Server push text is localised only for English and Hindi.

seen-and-welcome.name: Seen count and welcome
seen-and-welcome.summary: Your own post cards show a '👁 n seen' count that rises once per other person when at least 60% of the card was on their screen, and a 'Waypoint welcomed this post' mark (with a notification) appears if a first-time poster's text or poll has no reaction after 5 minutes.
seen-and-welcome.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion.
seen-and-welcome.story_hook: Ola posts for the first time and later sees that dozens of people had it on screen.
seen-and-welcome.safe_wording: Your own posts show how many other people had them on screen, counted once per person; a first post with no reaction after five minutes gets a welcome note from Waypoint.
seen-and-welcome.note: Welcome is sent by Waypoint, not by a fake person (welcome_first_posts cron every 5 minutes). Seen counts are batched after 2 seconds of quiet.

delete-own-post.name: Delete your own post
delete-own-post.summary: Your own text, poll and voice posts show a Delete link; confirming calls delete_my_post, which copies the post to a retention archive (default 180 days), removes it with its votes and reactions from the Wall at once and takes back 5 points.
delete-own-post.story_hook: Chidi posts a sentence, thinks again after dinner and deletes it.
delete-own-post.safe_wording: Delete any of your own posts at any time; it leaves the Wall straight away.
delete-own-post.note: Founder claim 'delete after saying' is only partly true. Real: manual Delete, any time, no 5-minute limit any more. Not real: no automatic self-delete timer on text or poll posts. Auto-removal that does exist: voice posts after 7 days, Moments after one view or 24 hours. Honesty problem: a copy goes to deleted_content_archive and is kept for log_retention_days (180 by default) for safety and legal requests, so 'gone', 'disappears' or 'untraceable' is false; describing the archive needs words on the forbidden list.

wall-sort-search-surprise.name: Top posts, search, surprise
wall-sort-search-surprise.summary: Pills on the Wall switch between New and Top today / week / month (get_top_feed), a dice button shows one random post (get_random_post) and a magnifier searches post text from two letters (search_posts).
wall-sort-search-surprise.story_hook: Hana searches the Wall for 'exam' the night before her test and opens Top today.
wall-sort-search-surprise.safe_wording: Sort the Wall by New or Top of the day, week or month, search the posts, or tap the dice for a random one.
wall-sort-search-surprise.note: Built 1 Oct; not in iOS build 15.

saved-posts.name: Saved posts
saved-posts.summary: A bookmark icon on other people's posts saves them to a list under My Waypoints > Saved, where each can be removed.
saved-posts.story_hook: Mateo bookmarks a post that made him laugh so he can read it again tomorrow.
saved-posts.safe_wording: Bookmark any post to keep it in a Saved list in My Waypoints.
saved-posts.note: saved_posts table and RLS are live. Reached only through My Waypoints. Saved list screenshot would be the empty state.

translate-content.name: Translate posts and chats
translate-content.summary: Under other people's Wall posts, poll questions and chat messages a Translate link calls the translate function (AI, cached per text and language) to show the text in your app language with a Show original link, and switches in My Waypoints and the chat header translate automatically.
translate-content.story_hook: Ines reads a post written in Hindi and taps Translate to read it in Spanish.
translate-content.safe_wording: Tap Translate under a post or chat message to read it in your own language, or switch on auto-translate.
translate-content.note: Verified live 12 and 17 Sep (Haiku 4.5). Depends on a valid ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (the key died 2-9 Oct and was replaced; it expires 31 Dec 2027). Voice posts are not translated. Chat bubbles from Mira are not translated.

languages.name: Sixteen app languages
languages.summary: The interface comes in 16 languages (English and Hindi inline in app/i18n/strings, plus 14 pack files in app/i18n/langs: Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Indonesian, Swahili), picked on the Language screen or from the device locale, with English as the fallback for missing text.
languages.story_hook: Rahul switches the whole app to Marathi while his sister keeps hers in English.
languages.safe_wording: The app is available in 16 languages, including nine Indian languages.
languages.note: Counted: 14 language pack files (plus index.ts and _template.json) + English + Hindi inline = 16. Nine are Indian (Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi). The 14 packs are machine-translated; native-speaker review still pending. Notification text from the server is localised only for English and Hindi. Newest v25 strings are in all 14 packs but only reach users with v25.

moments.name: Moments picture status
moments.summary: On the Wall's Moments strip you tap Add, take or choose a picture, it is uploaded and screened by AI before it can go live (rejected if a person may be under 18, nudity, gore, hate), stays live 24 hours, and the first other person to open it sees it for 10 seconds, can send one emoji reaction (love, laugh, wow, hug), and then it is gone for everyone, while you see Waiting / Opened / 'They reacted' and get a notification.
moments.story_hook: Zoe snaps the sunset from her balcony and shares it as a Moment; one stranger opens it and then it is gone.
moments.safe_wording: Share a picture that the first person to open it sees once, for ten seconds; after that it is gone for everyone.
moments.note: THIS IS THE FOUNDER'S 'ONE-TIME PICTURE STATUS' AND IT IS BUILT. The memory note that it must wait for iOS approval is stale: it was built 1 Oct (commit 9f146fc), edge functions screen-status-photo (Haiku then Opus, fails closed) and view-status-photo are in the repo and the 11 Oct schema snapshot has status_photos, claim_status_view, react_to_moment, my_moment_state and the cleanup cron. Not a friends feature: one global viewer per picture, no names, no replies. Android only (closed testing v21, production from v22; opened-state and reactions need v23+); iOS build 15 does not have it. In-app FAQ answer 8 still says 'There are no photos', which now contradicts it. Check store declarations (photos, camera) before promoting.

daily-news.name: News headlines on Explore
daily-news.summary: The Explore tab (titled Discover) shows a Listening Night card, a Calm kit card and then up to 10 random English headlines (lifestyle, entertainment, tourism, food, health) fetched each time from the fetch-news function (newsdata.io), each opening the article in the browser.
daily-news.gate: Not daily: a fresh random pick on every open and pull-to-refresh, English only, no theme choice. The function exists in the repo and config (verify_jwt false) but its deployment and the NEWSDATA_API_KEY secret cannot be verified offline; if either is missing the tab shows 'Nothing to show right now'.
daily-news.story_hook: Sam pulls to refresh Explore while waiting for a bus and opens a food story.
daily-news.safe_wording: The Explore tab lists ten random news headlines from outside sources; tap one to open the article.
daily-news.note: Founder claim 'daily news' = real but loose. There are no themes: marketing item wp-explore ('what people are saying tonight, by theme') is wrong; Explore shows outside news, not Waypoint posts. Headlines are third-party content; no user data is sent.

daily-path.name: Daily Path question
daily-path.summary: Each day at 16:00 UTC a server job writes one two-option question (a dilemma or a trivia question with a correct answer) and notifies everyone; you tap A or B once and next time you open the screen you see yesterday's results as percentages, with +10 points for a right trivia answer.
daily-path.story_hook: Ngozi answers tonight's question over tea and checks yesterday's results.
daily-path.safe_wording: One two-option question each day: pick an answer, then see how everyone answered the day before.
daily-path.note: Question is written by an AI model with a 14-question fallback bank (marked source='fallback' and watched by a daily canary); format changes by weekday. It is a pick-A-or-B question, not an open text answer. Result can be shared as an image. Wall widget says NEW DAILY PATH.

matching.name: Find someone to talk to
matching.summary: On the Chats tab you pick what you are looking for (five options) and who to meet (different feeling, same feeling or anyone), tap Find someone to talk to, and the app joins a waiting pool and asks find_or_create_match every 3 seconds; after 15 seconds it offers Mira, after 45 seconds it lets you leave a note on the Wall, and a match opens the Matched screen with Start talking or Not now.
matching.story_hook: Karan taps Find someone to talk to after dinner and is paired with a person who just joined.
matching.safe_wording: Pick what you are looking for and tap Find someone to talk to; when a second person is looking too, you are paired for a short chat.
matching.note: Real code path to find_or_create_match, waiting_pool and realtime. Needs two people online at the same moment; the Chats tab shows a live online count. Memory notes say live matching rarely finds anyone below roughly 1,000 weekly actives, so do not promise a quick pairing. Notes left while waiting are posted to the Wall as 'Note' posts. Related in-app route: /matched.

chat.name: Timed one-to-one chat
chat.summary: A matched chat is text-only and lasts 30 minutes, with a typing indicator, long-press emoji reactions, copy and report on any message, an End button that unlocks after 5 minutes, Block at any time, optional auto-translate, automatic removal of flagged messages, and a Good / Okay / Not great rating at the end.
chat.story_hook: Elif and a stranger trade stories for the 30 minutes it takes her laundry to dry.
chat.safe_wording: A chat with one other person lasts 30 minutes; you can react to messages, translate them, block the person, or end it after five minutes.
chat.note: Four independent realtime channels plus a 4-second poll fallback. Messages screened after sending (moderate-message). In-app help text says chats run '5 to 30 minutes' (End is allowed from minute 5).

mira-guide.name: Mira, the AI guide
mira-guide.summary: 'Talk to Mira' on the Chats tab or while waiting for a match starts a chat with an automated AI guide (Claude Haiku) that opens with 'Hi, I'm Mira. I'm an AI guide, not a person', replies in one or two sentences, goes through the same reactions, report, block and screening as a person chat, and closes after 40 of your messages.
mira-guide.story_hook: At midnight the online count shows zero, so Jo says hello to Mira instead.
mira-guide.safe_wording: Mira is an automated AI guide you can chat with at any time; she replies in a sentence or two and says plainly that she is not a person.
mira-guide.note: Live since 24 Sep (built for App Review 2.1(a)). The monthly cap setting guide_chats_per_month exists but is unset (cap off per the memory notes). The system prompt includes self-harm handling, so do not market Mira as emotional help. Needs a valid Anthropic key.

break-room.name: Break Room
break-room.summary: From the bat icon on the Wall you swipe a bat through a drawn room; 20 breakable objects crack and break in stages with recorded sounds and vibration, 6 solid objects push back, a round is 90 seconds from your first swing, the room locks for the rest of that (UTC) day afterwards, your best count is kept and the score can be shared as an image.
break-room.story_hook: Mia swings the bat for ninety seconds between meetings and breaks the TV.
break-room.safe_wording: Swipe a bat through a drawn room for 90 seconds, once a day, and break whatever is in the way, with sound and vibration.
break-room.note: Purely on the phone: the once-a-day lock uses the phone's date (AsyncStorage), so it can be bypassed; nothing leaves the phone except the optional share image and the optional check-in answer. Destroyed objects respawn after 15 seconds. On Android the swipes were dead until the GestureHandlerRootView fix in v23 (commit 7d096d1).

calm-kit.name: Calm kit
calm-kit.summary: The Calm kit (a card on Explore, a link on Chats when nobody is online, and a button on the pause screen) offers Breathe (two minutes of 4-4-4-4 box breathing with a growing circle and soft vibration), Ground yourself (a 5-4-3-2-1 senses walk-through, one step per screen, optional note that is never saved) and Wind down (three minutes, screen dims, three prompts, Good night), each ending with a Lighter / Same question.
calm-kit.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion.
calm-kit.story_hook: Ben has two minutes before a presentation and opens Breathe.
calm-kit.safe_wording: The Calm kit has three short timed tools: two minutes of box breathing, a five-senses step-through, and a three-minute screen-dimming wind-down.
calm-kit.note: No account or upload; the only server call is the one-row Lighter/Same log (log_checkin) and the only stored value is the soft-vibration mute. Marketing item wp-calm-kit says it is 'in Waypoint now': true in code, not in any published build yet. 'Calm kit' is the one allowed use of the word calm.

quick-exit.name: Quick exit button
quick-exit.summary: A setting in My Waypoints adds a small Exit button to the Wall and Calm kit; one tap closes the app on Android, or on iPhone opens a plain 'Notes' list page (cover) where three taps on the title within 1.5 seconds return to the app.
quick-exit.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion. Also off by default: the person turns it on in My Waypoints.
quick-exit.story_hook: Tara taps Exit when a colleague walks up behind her desk.
quick-exit.safe_wording: An optional Exit button closes the app in one tap; on iPhone it shows a plain Notes page, and three quick taps on its title bring Waypoint back.
quick-exit.note: The mechanics are describable without forbidden words, but the reason it exists (a shared phone or a person nearby) needs words such as 'someone else' or 'private'; the founder should decide how far to explain the purpose. The Notes page is a disguise, nothing is stored or sent.

checkins.name: Lighter, same, heavier check-in
checkins.summary: After you post, finish a chat or a Break Room round (and from a next-evening reminder) a quiet card asks 'How do you feel now?' with Lighter / Same / Heavier (at most 3 a day, skippable), logs one row (context and answer, no text) through log_checkin, and may schedule one 8 pm reminder if notifications are already allowed.
checkins.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion.
checkins.story_hook: After finishing a chat, Omar taps Lighter and goes back to his evening.
checkins.safe_wording: After a post, a chat or a Break Room round, one card asks how you feel now and you tap Lighter, Same or Heavier.
checkins.note: The founder wants to publish an outcome number ('x% felt lighter') from outcome_stats, which only the service role can read. A published percentage is an outcome claim; take care with wording. Screenshot route /mood?checkback=1 shows the card on its own.

mood-log.name: Daily feelings log
mood-log.summary: In My Waypoints > Mood log you tap one of nine moods for morning, afternoon, evening or night (up to four taps a day, no typing), see this week against the week before, and can switch on one 9 pm daily reminder.
mood-log.story_hook: Yuki taps a feeling after lunch and again in the evening, and glances at her week on Sunday.
mood-log.safe_wording: Tap a feeling for morning, afternoon, evening or night, up to four taps a day, and see how your week compares with the one before.
mood-log.note: In-app name is 'Mood log' and the word 'mood' is forbidden in captions; a plain name such as 'feelings log' avoids it. The reminder notification reads 'How are you feeling?'. mood_logs table and log_mood are in the live schema. This is the founder's 'mood check-in'; the Lighter/Same/Heavier card is the separate 'checkins' feature.

wrapped.name: Monthly recap
wrapped.summary: My Waypoints > This month opens a recap of the current month with posts shared, reactions given, thumbs-up and laughs received, and the feeling you logged most, computed by get_my_month_recap for your account only.
wrapped.story_hook: On the first of the month Leo opens his recap and sees he posted twelve times.
wrapped.safe_wording: A monthly recap with the number of posts you shared, reactions you gave, and thumbs-up and laughs you received.
wrapped.note: Called 'Wrapped' in the code and 'This month' in the app. The top-feeling line only appears if you used the feelings log. Capture would show zeros.

my-waypoints.name: My Waypoints
my-waypoints.summary: Tapping your name chip on the Wall opens My Waypoints with days on the app, points, tier and rank, your own posts from the last 30 days with their reaction counts, links to Saved, This month and Mood log, switches for auto-translate and the Exit button, copy-name and copy-account-ID rows, the invite card, help links and Delete my account.
my-waypoints.story_hook: Fatima checks her points and her last month of posts.
my-waypoints.safe_wording: My Waypoints shows your points, your rank, your own posts from the last 30 days, and your settings.
my-waypoints.note: Only the last 30 days of your own posts are listed (a client query), so marketing item wp-my-waypoints ('every sentence you have said') overclaims. The Exit switch is v25; the copy-account-ID row is v22.

leaderboard.name: Points and leaderboard
leaderboard.summary: Points (5 for a post, 1 for a reaction, 10 for a right trivia answer or an invite) rank everyone daily; the Leaderboard lists the top 50 by today's name with tiers (Gold top 10%, Silver next 20%) and your own standing, badges show beside names on the Wall, and a notification arrives when your tier changes.
leaderboard.story_hook: Chen sees he is in the top 10% today and has a gold badge.
leaderboard.safe_wording: Earn points for posting and reacting and see where you stand among the day's top 50 on the Leaderboard.
leaderboard.note: get_leaderboard, get_my_rank and get_all_tiers are in the live snapshot. The 9 Oct audit noted these calls expose stable account ids, so do not imply unlinkable names.

listening-night.name: Weekly scheduled night
listening-night.summary: A weekly hour scheduled by the founder (npm run night -- add): the card on Explore and Chats shows the time and seats saved (15 needed by default), you tap Save my seat, get one reminder 30 minutes before that says whether it runs, and while it is live a Join now button starts normal matching.
listening-night.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion. AND the founder must schedule a night with npm run night; with none scheduled Explore says 'No Listening Night scheduled yet.' and Chats hides the card.
listening-night.story_hook: On Saturday at 9 Aisha saves a seat and gets a reminder half an hour before it starts.
listening-night.safe_wording: A weekly scheduled hour when more people are in the app: save a seat, get a reminder 30 minutes before, and join with one tap when it starts.
listening-night.note: In-app name is 'Listening Night' and the word 'listening' is forbidden in captions. It does not match anyone by itself; it only gathers people so normal matching is likely to find a partner. Tables listening_nights and listening_seats and the cron listening-night-remind are live per the 11 Oct snapshot; no night was scheduled as of the last notes.

official-carousel.name: Official team card
official-carousel.summary: A green 'OFFICIAL · WAYPOINT' card at the top of the Wall rotates up to five founder messages every 7 seconds with swipe, dots and an optional button (Send feedback, See how it works, Update), with a footer saying Waypoint never posts on the Wall or messages in chat; update notes retire themselves once you have the new build.
official-carousel.gate: The rotating five-message carousel needs the Android v25 build; the single newest-message card is already live in older builds. Messages come from the announcements table via npm run announce.
official-carousel.story_hook: Ben opens the app and the green card says a new version is out.
official-carousel.safe_wording: A card at the top of the Wall shows short news from the Waypoint team, up to five messages that rotate on their own.
official-carousel.note: Pauses while touched, in the background, on another tab, and with Reduce Motion. Five rows were seeded on 11 Oct (update, feedback, safety, Moments, Mira).

whats-new.name: What's New list
whats-new.summary: How Waypoint works > What's New lists every row of the announcements table with its date, title and body.
whats-new.story_hook: Raj opens What's New to see what changed this week.
whats-new.safe_wording: What's New lists the team's announcements with their dates.
whats-new.note: Reached from 'How this works' on the start screen. Shows whatever the founder has posted (the same table feeds the green card), empty text otherwise.

first-three.name: React to three posts first
first-three.summary: After choosing why you came, you see three recent posts from other people with the Wall's reaction buttons; one tap earns a thank-you line and the notification ask, then Continue (or Skip) takes you to Create with that feeling, or to the Wall.
first-three.gate: Needs the Android v25 build (not confirmed built or published as of the 11 Oct 2026 notes); iOS needs a new build after the Apple team conversion.
first-three.story_hook: A new user taps a reaction on one of three posts within the first minute.
first-three.safe_wording: New users first see three recent posts and can react with one tap before writing anything.
first-three.note: Screen is skipped when the feed is empty or still loading after 4 seconds. Shows real posts by other people.

reveal.name: Name reveal and reminder
reveal.summary: After the onboarding question the Reveal screen shows today's generated name and avatar with a Customize link, a line tied to your answer and a button to the first action, plus a one-time opt-in 'Remind me when my new name arrives' that schedules one local notification for 19:00 the next day.
reveal.story_hook: Noor sees her first name for the day and asks for a reminder when the next one arrives.
reveal.safe_wording: On your first day the app shows you today's generated name and avatar, and lets you ask for one reminder when the next name arrives.
reveal.note: Reveal is live everywhere; the reminder opt-in and the first-three hand-off are v25. Page text includes 'nobody will recognize you', which should not be reused.

welcome-age-gate.name: Intro and 18+ gate
welcome-age-gate.summary: Start opens a skippable animated intro (shown again only after 7 days), then an 18+ gate with Terms and Community Guidelines links and a required agree checkbox (choosing 'I am under 18' blocks the device), then a three-option 'What brings you here today?' screen.
welcome-age-gate.story_hook: Luca installs the app, skims the intro in ten seconds and confirms he is 18 or older.
welcome-age-gate.safe_wording: New users read a short intro, confirm they are 18 or older and agree to the terms, then answer one question about why they came.
welcome-age-gate.note: Under-18 choice is remembered on the device (blocked screen, contact email only). Landing also has the language button and 'How this works'. Onboarding option text is 'I need to let something out' / 'I want to share something good' / 'I just want to listen'.

invite.name: Invite with a code
invite.summary: My Waypoints shows your invite code with a Share invite link button; a new account can redeem a code in its first 7 days (or open waypoint://invite/CODE) and both people get 10 points.
invite.story_hook: Priya sends her cousin her code and both get ten points.
invite.safe_wording: Share your invite code; when a new person redeems it in their first week, you both get 10 points.
invite.note: Tables invites and invite_redemptions plus redeem_invite are in the live snapshot. The in-app text says invited friends will 'never know which Waypointer you are' (forbidden word 'never').

share-cards.name: Share as an image
share-cards.summary: A Share button on posts, the Break Room result and the Daily Path result renders a branded image with the app link and opens the phone's share sheet, falling back to plain text if the capture module is missing.
share-cards.story_hook: Sofia shares her Daily Path answer as an image to her group chat.
share-cards.safe_wording: Share a post, your Break Room score or your Daily Path result as an image with the app link.
share-cards.note: The post card says 'Someone said this anonymously on Waypoint' on the image itself, and it carries another person's post text and name out of the app. Uses react-native-view-shot and expo-sharing (native, in builds since mid-Sep).

report-and-block.name: Report and block
report-and-block.summary: Other people's posts have flag and block actions (Report hides the post from you and flags it for automated review; Block author hides all their posts and ends matching with them); in chat Report sends their latest message, a long-press reports any message and Block ends the chat; Moments and replies can be reported too.
report-and-block.story_hook: Dan sees an abusive post, flags it and blocks the author.
report-and-block.safe_wording: Every post, chat message, picture and reply can be reported, and you can block any author or chat partner.
report-and-block.note: Added for the App Store 1.2 rejections (20-26 Sep). Backend: reports and message_reports tables, block_user, report_status, report_reply, block_replier, hourly review-reports cron. Unique constraints stop duplicate reports.

pre-post-screening.name: Automated pre-post review
pre-post-screening.summary: Before a text post, poll or reply is published, the app sends the text to the screen-post function (AI classifier); harassment, hate, sexual content and threats are refused with 'Can't post this', and if the check errors or takes over 6 seconds the post goes through; chat messages and voice transcripts are screened after sending.
pre-post-screening.story_hook: Alex writes an angry reply full of insults and is told it cannot be posted as written.
pre-post-screening.safe_wording: An automated system reads each post before it goes up and refuses abuse, hate, sexual content and threats.
pre-post-screening.note: The natural words for this feature (screened, moderated, filter, checked by) are all on the forbidden list; the alternative wording given works but the founder should confirm. It fails open by design (an error means the post publishes) and depends on the Anthropic key (silent failure 2-9 Oct, now watched by a daily canary).

helpline-pause.name: Pause screen with phone numbers
helpline-pause.summary: If the text of a post or poll question contains certain crisis phrases, a 'Before you post...' screen lists regional helpline numbers (India, Nigeria, US, UK plus a global finder), a 'Try a calm tool' button to the Calm kit, and 'Don't post yet' / 'Post anyway'.
helpline-pause.story_hook: Before a post goes out, a pause screen lists phone numbers for the person's country.
helpline-pause.safe_wording: If a draft contains certain phrases, a pause screen shows phone numbers for local help lines before you choose to post or wait.
helpline-pause.note: The honest description is about crisis helplines and uses words on the forbidden list (suicide, support, mental health). Recommend not marketing this feature. The 'Try a calm tool' button is v25.

not-official-label.name: Not-official warning label
not-official-label.summary: Posts, poll questions, replies and chat messages whose text claims to be Waypoint staff get a 'Posted by a Waypointer, not by Waypoint' warning, custom names that sound like staff are refused, and the server stamps the real name on each post.
not-official-label.story_hook: Kim sees a post claiming to be from the Waypoint team and notices the warning label.
not-official-label.safe_wording: A warning label appears on any post or message that claims to come from the Waypoint team.
not-official-label.note: Added 12 Sep. The green Official card footer repeats the same promise.

removed-account-appeal.name: Removed account notice
removed-account-appeal.summary: An account ejected for breaking the rules (or a new account on a device an ejected account used) sees a full-screen notice over the whole app with a Contact link; v25 adds a one-line reason category and a 500-character appeal box.
removed-account-appeal.gate: Reason and appeal form (my_ban, appeal_ban) need the Android v25 build; the plain removed-account notice is live in all builds.
removed-account-appeal.story_hook: A removed user sees why and sends one appeal.
removed-account-appeal.safe_wording: If an account is removed, a full-screen notice explains why in one line and lets the person send one appeal.
removed-account-appeal.note: Device linking (register_device) means a fresh account on the same device is ejected too. Appeals are stored in ban_appeals for the founder to read.

delete-account.name: Delete account and data
delete-account.summary: My Waypoints > Delete my account and data asks for confirmation, then calls delete_my_account, which archives content for the retention period, removes the account's posts, messages, points, logs, Moments, invites and login, and starts a fresh generated account on the phone.
delete-account.story_hook: Pedro decides to leave the app and deletes his account from My Waypoints.
delete-account.safe_wording: You can delete your account and data from My Waypoints at any time.
delete-account.note: The in-app dialog says it 'permanently removes all your posts, messages, points and activity', but delete_my_account first copies content to deleted_content_archive and keeps access_log, device and ban rows for log_retention_days (180 by default). The honest wording about what is kept needs words on the forbidden list. Required by the store account-deletion rules.

push-notifications.name: Optional notifications
push-notifications.summary: The OS permission is asked only after a first real action (post, reaction, Daily Path answer, chat message) through an in-app sheet; notifications cover new matches and messages, reactions, poll votes, tonight's Daily Path question, tier changes and Moments opened or reacted to, plus local reminders (9:00 'You're someone new today' and optional evening reminders).
push-notifications.story_hook: Ayo gets a notification that tonight's question is ready.
push-notifications.safe_wording: Optional notifications tell you about matches, messages, reactions and the daily question.
push-notifications.note: send-notification builds the text on the server; its dictionary is only English and Hindi. v25 adds reply, thanks, check-back, new-name and night notifications. The 'someone reacted' texts are neutral so they are safe on a lock screen.

help-faq-legal.name: Help, FAQ and legal links
help-faq-legal.summary: How Waypoint works (reached from the start screen) explains posting, reacting, matching, Daily Path, Break Room, customizing and reporting, and links to an 8-question FAQ, the contact email, Terms, Community Guidelines, Child Safety Standards and the Privacy Policy, which are also repeated at the foot of My Waypoints, Chats and Explore.
help-faq-legal.story_hook: Wale reads the FAQ to find out how points work.
help-faq-legal.safe_wording: How Waypoint works, eight FAQ answers and the legal pages are one tap away.
help-faq-legal.note: Contradictions to fix: FAQ answer 8 says 'There are no photos' (Moments exist); FAQ answer 3 promises posts age out after 30 days (not verified server-side). Contact email is the founder's personal address.

feedback.name: Send feedback
feedback.summary: The Feedback screen saves a typed message to the feedback table (rate-limited by a trigger), reachable from How Waypoint works, the help links and the green card button.
feedback.story_hook: Grace suggests a small change from the Feedback screen.
feedback.safe_wording: Send the team a note about what works or what to change.
feedback.note: feedback table and check_feedback_rate_limit are in the live snapshot.

update-and-offline.name: Update and offline notices
update-and-offline.summary: A banner offers 'A new version is ready' (Later / Update) when the server's latest build number is higher than yours, a full-screen 'Please update' blocks builds below a set minimum, and a coral bar says there is no internet connection when the phone is offline.
update-and-offline.gate: The update banner only appears on builds from v23 on, and only for numbers the founder has registered with npm run release:version (latest 24, no minimum as of 11 Oct).
update-and-offline.story_hook: Ben sees a banner that a new version is ready and taps Update.
update-and-offline.safe_wording: The app tells you when a newer version is out and when your phone is offline.
update-and-offline.note: Older builds can never learn about updates. The offline bar works in all builds.
